title: Junta Jet Bombs Hlaytinu Village in Myaung Township, Killing Volunteer Teacher and Child
detail: On August 19, 2026, junta fighter jets bombed Hlaytinu Village, Myaung Township, Sagaing Region — an anti-regime resistance stronghold where the military exerts little ground control but relies heavily on aerial bombardment. Reports diverge on the toll: Burma News International reported two civilians killed, including a volunteer teacher, and 16 injured; a separate account cited 2 killed and 19 injured. The strike preceded a far deadlier junta airstrike on a monastery in the same township two days later.

media.caption: Junta airstrikes continue in Myaung Township, Sagaing Region, days before the deadly monastery bombing.

title: Artillery Shell Kills 5-Year-Old, Injures 11 at Village Football Field in Kyaikto Township
detail: An artillery shell exploded at approximately 11am on August 19, 2026 at a village football field in Zeepyaung Village, Thein Za Yat Town, Kyaikto Township, Mon State, during a rainy-season football match. A 5-year-old kindergarten student was killed and 11 civilians were injured, four critically; the seriously wounded were transferred to Bago General Hospital. Residents said junta troops frequently conduct military operations and indiscriminate artillery shelling in the area, which is administered by Karen National Union (KNU) Brigade 1.

media.caption: An artillery shell kills a 5-year-old and injures 11 at a village football field in Kyaikto Township, Mon State.
